reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds applied by Alpha Co. My first step is to check if the refunds recorded in the system match the refunds reported by Alpha Co. I will use the list_refunds() tool for this.

I have listed the refunds from the system. The reported refunds from Alpha Co are for order_ids 360, 361, and 363. The system refunds show entries for order_ids 360 and 363, but they are missing the refund for order_id 361. Since the reported refunds do not match the system records, I must issue a hold to stop the payout process for review.
